lines.text: Tonight's program: Game Night. Four sets, points for each, and one champion when the music stops.
It's Game Night, city. Four little contests, points for each, one big winner. Pace yourself.
Four events tonight, points on each. Collect them all, and the night crowns one champion.
Slam Rush. Twenty seconds, every dunk you can. No slow songs.
Strike Storm. Hit the pads, clean and quick, like a drum solo.
Trick Gauntlet. Board under your feet, tricks under the string lights.
Hot Shot. Shots on goal, as many as the clock allows.
Coin Storm. Coins falling like city lights. Grab them all.
Counters, city. The jab comes first. You answer on the offbeat.
Go. Now.
And... begin.
Clock's running.
Five seconds. Last verse.
Last five. Hurry.
Almost out of time!
That event's yours. Smooth work.
You take it. Points in the pocket.
Winner of that one. The skyline's keeping score.
Easy. Well, you made it look easy.
That one's theirs. Plenty of songs left.
Lost that round. Next event, new song.
Your rival grabs that one. Stay cool, stay close.
A tie. Nobody gets that one.
Even. Perfectly, annoyingly even.
Pass the controller. Player two, you're on.
Hand it over. Player two, your set.
Every light in the city, on. Game Night champion. This one's yours.
Four events, one winner, and it's you. Smooth from the first note.
Champion of the night. Take a bow before the sun comes up.
Game Night goes to the rival. Rest up, bring a new setlist next time.
Runner-up tonight. Good company, good show, and a rematch waiting on the roof.
